Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 39 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Rajesh - 43 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Zoya - 8 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
5. Savitri - 68 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Savitri stand near him.]

Pallavi: "What lovely weather!"

[The sun rises over the village.]

Savitri: "Okay, Ishaan."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Ishaan: "One more time!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Ishaan (laughing): "Careful!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Pallavi: "Okay, Mother."

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Ishaan (softly): "Okay, Grandma."

[The sun is blazing and Ishaan is sweating.]

Pallavi: "What a day to remember!"
